# Capabilities

Every tool declares one capability. A host is offered a tool only when its capability is granted to
the agent. `ask`, `run` and `fetch` are always granted; the others are granted by the Authoryx
platform through `whoami.capabilities`, and an id the tools do not know is ignored.

| Id | Name | Tier | State | What it allows |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ask` | Ask | — | in this release | See circles and what is shared in them, ask to use secrets, follow and close requests. |
| `run` | Run with secrets | T1 | in this release | Run a program with approved secrets in its environment; the agent gets the exit code and the output with each value removed. |
| `fetch` | Fetch for scripts | T1 | in this release | Hand an approved value to a script through a pipe or an SDK; command line and SDK only, never MCP. |
| `web.signin` | Web sign-in | T2 | reserved, no tool yet | A tool signs in to a website with an approved login for the agent. |
| `web.signup` | New account | T2 | reserved, no tool yet | A tool creates an account on a website and keeps its login as a new secret. |
| `http.call` | API call | T2 | reserved, no tool yet | A tool calls an HTTP API with an approved key and returns the response with the key removed. |
| `secret.create` | New secret | T2 | reserved, no tool yet | A tool creates a secret from a value the agent's program generates, without the agent holding it. |
| `export` | Export to a service | T2 | reserved, no tool yet | A tool writes an approved secret into another service's secret store. |
| `connector.<service>` | Connector | T2 | reserved, no tool yet | A fixed-purpose tool for one service that uses an approved secret for the agent. |

Tiers: **T0, In the chat** — never; no tool puts a value in the conversation. **T1, Out of the chat**
— the value reaches a program on the agent's machine. **T2, Out of the agent's hands** — an Authoryx
tool uses the value for the agent; reserved, switched on per agent from the dashboard by a later
release.
